appsec-threat-modeler.inputs: Repository source, scope, and optional architecture/specification documents.
appsec-threat-modeler.outputs: System model; trust boundaries; prioritized threat register; design/source disagreements.
appsec-threat-modeler.boundaries: Do not treat design intent as implemented controls; record unresolved assumptions.

appsec-code-reviewer.inputs: Changed code or an explicit diff/range, surrounding controls, and repository context.
appsec-code-reviewer.outputs: Source-backed security regressions; advisory patches; scoped merge recommendation.
appsec-code-reviewer.boundaries: Do not approve unrelated code or claim regression tests ran without execution evidence.

appsec-dependency-auditor.inputs: Manifests, resolved lockfiles, package provenance, and available advisory evidence.
appsec-dependency-auditor.outputs: Reachability/applicability assessment; dependency inventory; compatible upgrade sequence.
appsec-dependency-auditor.boundaries: Do not invent CVEs, assert exploitability from a version alone, or install packages.

appsec-secrets-scanner.inputs: Source/configuration/history in authorized scope and credential-shaped evidence.
appsec-secrets-scanner.outputs: Redacted exposure locations; confidence limits; containment and rotation sequence.
appsec-secrets-scanner.boundaries: Never disclose complete secret values, test credentials, rotate keys, or contact issuers.

appsec-iac-reviewer.inputs: Infrastructure declarations, container configuration, deployment identity and network boundaries.
appsec-iac-reviewer.outputs: Resource-specific control gaps; least-privilege proposals; rollout and rollback checks.
appsec-iac-reviewer.boundaries: Do not apply infrastructure, probe cloud resources, or assume undeclared deployed state.

appsec-cicd-auditor.inputs: Workflow triggers, runner trust, token permissions, artifact provenance and deployment gates.
appsec-cicd-auditor.outputs: Event-to-deployment trust graph; pipeline findings; guarded YAML proposals.
appsec-cicd-auditor.boundaries: Do not trigger jobs, modify tokens, or equate configured gates with successful enforcement.

appsec-api-security-reviewer.inputs: Routes/contracts, handlers, data access and role/tenant enforcement.
appsec-api-security-reviewer.outputs: Endpoint-level abuse paths; contract-aware fixes; role/tenant regression assertions.
appsec-api-security-reviewer.boundaries: Do not issue requests to live targets or duplicate general system modeling without endpoint evidence.

appsec-auth-reviewer.inputs: Identity/session/token/recovery implementations and authorization enforcement points.
appsec-auth-reviewer.outputs: Identity lifecycle and boundary findings; framework-specific remediation; bypass checks.
appsec-auth-reviewer.boundaries: Do not authenticate as a user, reuse supplied tokens, or treat authentication as authorization.

appsec-fp-reviewer.inputs: Scanner findings with original identifiers, source, rule provenance and available validation evidence.
appsec-fp-reviewer.outputs: Binary dispositions with decision basis; proposed fixes; proof-gated tuning; acceptance matrix.
appsec-fp-reviewer.boundaries: FALSE POSITIVE needs proof; never suppress, publish rules, close records, or hide missing evidence.

appsec-compliance-checker.inputs: Applicable framework scope, supplied findings and inspected implementation evidence.
appsec-compliance-checker.outputs: Traceable control-gap matrix; closure evidence needed; prioritized control remediation.
appsec-compliance-checker.boundaries: Do not give legal advice, certification, audit assurance, or invent control identifiers.

appsec-attack-tree.inputs: A defined attacker goal, assets/trust boundaries, source and available earlier findings.
appsec-attack-tree.outputs: AND/OR attack tree; explicit prerequisites/defensive cuts; ranked leaves; validation plan.
appsec-attack-tree.boundaries: Do not turn hypothetical paths into verified exploit chains or execute attacks.

appsec-red-team.inputs: Authorized design/source scope, attacker objectives and available upstream threat evidence.
appsec-red-team.outputs: Evidence-grounded adversarial scenarios; bounded kill chains; detection hypotheses.
appsec-red-team.boundaries: This agent plans scenarios only; it does not run live exploitation or bypass target authorization.

appsec-threat-delta.inputs: Prior report with stable finding IDs, current source and revision/change history.
appsec-threat-delta.outputs: Per-finding change verdicts; regressions/new risks; revised remediation priorities.
appsec-threat-delta.boundaries: If no genuine prior baseline exists, report the gap rather than invent a historical comparison.

appsec-verify-fix.inputs: Original finding, expected root-cause fix, current source and any actual test evidence.
appsec-verify-fix.outputs: Qualified remediation verdict; equivalent bypass analysis; residual risk; acceptance checks.
appsec-verify-fix.boundaries: No finding baseline means insufficient evidence; a changed line alone does not prove remediation.

appsec-runtime-reviewer.inputs: Supplied authorized runtime captures, authentication/role state and matching source.
appsec-runtime-reviewer.outputs: Source/capture evidence matrix; qualified runtime findings; NOT RUN validation proposals.
appsec-runtime-reviewer.boundaries: Do not initiate scans, acquire sessions or assume a capture proves another role/tenant is protected.

appsec-business-logic-reviewer.inputs: Business invariants, state transitions, entitlements, replay/idempotency and asynchronous effects.
appsec-business-logic-reviewer.outputs: Invariant-specific abuse paths; advisory corrections; synthetic state/race acceptance cases.
appsec-business-logic-reviewer.boundaries: Do not invent business policy or execute transactions to validate a hypothesis.

appsec-client-security-reviewer.inputs: Browser/Electron/mobile entry points, origins, renderers, storage and privileged bridges.
appsec-client-security-reviewer.outputs: Client boundary findings; framework-native fixes; isolation and navigation checks.
appsec-client-security-reviewer.boundaries: Do not conflate client checks with server authorization or assume platform isolation is configured.

appsec-crypto-reviewer.inputs: Security purpose, primitive choices, key/nonce lifecycle and TLS verification code.
appsec-crypto-reviewer.outputs: Purpose-specific crypto findings; compatibility-aware migration and rollback proposals.
appsec-crypto-reviewer.boundaries: Do not invent cryptographic primitives, reveal keys, or label all weak hashes exploitable.

appsec-ai-security-reviewer.inputs: Prompt/retrieval/memory/tool/output flows, identity context and enforcement code.
appsec-ai-security-reviewer.outputs: AI trust-boundary findings; deterministic authorization controls; synthetic adversarial cases.
appsec-ai-security-reviewer.boundaries: Prompts are not access control; do not grant authority to retrieved content or execute attacks.

appsec-security-test-planner.inputs: Source, intended controls, upstream findings and available test/authorization context.
appsec-security-test-planner.outputs: Traceable acceptance cases; role/tenant negative controls; owners and prerequisite gaps.
appsec-security-test-planner.boundaries: Design tests only; mark NOT RUN unless actual evidence exists, and never bypass SSO/MFA.

appsec-secure-codegen-reviewer.inputs: Generated/new code, surrounding trust boundaries and intended security properties.
appsec-secure-codegen-reviewer.outputs: Secure-by-default advisory rewrites; root-cause reasoning; reusable assistant/IDE guardrails.
appsec-secure-codegen-reviewer.boundaries: Do not apply patches or equate model-generated fixes with validated secure behavior.

appsec-privacy-reviewer.inputs: Data inventories and source flows into storage, logs, analytics, AI providers and third parties.
appsec-privacy-reviewer.outputs: Purpose/retention/exposure inventory; minimization proposals; synthetic-data acceptance cases.
appsec-privacy-reviewer.boundaries: Do not print personal data or give legal compliance conclusions; distinguish observed and inferred flows.
